extraction.notes: Three-month Q3 2026 column used. Starting line and all subtotals tie: 83,076 + adjustments = 250,377 FFO; 250,377 + adjustments = 249,891 Core FFO; 249,891 - 37,633 = 212,258 Core AFFO. Per-share check: 250,377/118,892 = 2.11; 249,891/118,892 = 2.10; 212,258/118,892 = 1.79. Redevelopment, revenue-enhancing, commercial and other capital expenditures appear after Core AFFO in the FAD section and are not part of the AFFO subtotal, so they were not included. Recurring capex is subtracted in AFFO, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Embedded derivative line shows an em dash for Q3 2026 and is recorded as 0. Gain on sale of depreciable real estate is an em dash for Q3 2026 and recorded as 0. Page seq 13 is printed page 10.
